Mern stack Development 2025
 This project is a full-stack web application developed using the MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js). The
main goal of this project is to provide users with a secure and easy-to-use platform to manage their data online.The application
supports full CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete), allowing users to add, view, edit, and delete their records. Security
features like authentication and data validation are implemented to protect user data.-Link
